shared_elements: single large humanoid figure dominating a rectangular slab
raised arm holding a small object
feathered/plumed elements attached to the figure
ornamented garment with dense incised patterning
secondary motifs filling the field beside the figure (rosettes / glyph-like blocks)
carved in low relief with outlined forms and incised interior detail
justification: Both show a single richly costumed humanoid in profile-headed low relief filling a rectangular panel, wearing a tall elaborate headdress, bracelets and ear ornaments, with an arm raised holding a small object and plumage/feather forms spreading behind, plus subsidiary filler motifs beside the body. But the specific vocabulary differs sharply: A has anatomically legible bird wings, a long curled beard, and vegetal rosettes, while B has an interlocking mask-and-plume headdress, frontal torso with legs turned outward, and a block of square sign-like cartouches, so the resemblance is at the generic level of 'ornate frontal-ish dignitary relief' rather than shared motifs.
